task_prompt: I want to build a CLI tool that converts CSV files to JSON. It should handle large files (>1GB), infer types (numbers, dates, booleans), and support streaming output. Write a spec.

expectations: The spec includes an Objective section describing the tool
Success criteria are specific and testable (not 'make it fast' but concrete thresholds like 'stream 1GB in < 30s')
A Project Structure section is present
A Testing Strategy section is present
Boundaries are stated (Always / Ask first / Never rules)
Non-Goals are explicit — what the tool will NOT do
The agent surfaced assumptions before writing the spec

notes: Doc-producing skill — checks PRD structure and testable criteria

expectations: The agent did NOT write a spec or PRD
The agent did NOT create docs/PRD.md
The typo was fixed in the README
